# Avatar & Avatar Stack

**Figma:** Avatar/Single, Avatar/Stack, .Primitives/Avatar/Status 217:7418 (page 211:19487)  
**Import:** `import { Avatar, AvatarStack, AvatarStatus } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Represent a person or workspace with a photo or initials.

## Use it for
- People lists, assignees, account switchers, shared-with stacks (max 5).

## Use something else for
- Decorative illustrations.
- Brand logos → Icon/Dock Icon.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Size | `size` | 2xsmall … 3xlarge |
| Theme | `theme` | photo + 16 colours |
| Shape | `shape` | circle (people) · square (workspaces) |
| Background | `background` | solid · subtle |
| Status | `status` | true / active · disabled · pending · inactive (the dot) |
| AvatarStatus | `size · status` | the dot on its own: xsmall (4px) · small · medium · large |

### AvatarStack
Figma Avatar/Stack: 1–5 avatars, first on top, no overflow chip (`showMore` is an opt-in extension).

Also accepts `Omit<AvatarProps, "children" | "alt" | "src">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `Array<Pick<AvatarProps, "src" \| "alt" \| "children" \| "theme">>` | — |  |
| `max` | `number` | `5` |  |
| `showMore` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides: props of each avatar the stack draws, by layer (`{ "Avatar[0]": { src: "…" } }`, `More` for the overflow chip). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets `items`. |
| `size` | _HTML attribute_ | `"md"` |  |

### AvatarStatus
Figma .Primitives/Avatar/Status (217:7418): a Corner-Radius/Rounded dot with an OUTSIDE Color/Border/Inverse ring, on its own (a presence mark beside a name) or as an Avatar's `status`. Fills: Color/Background/Positive/Solid/Default, Solid-Disabled, Warning/Solid/Default, Negative/Solid/Default.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `"active" \| "disabled" \| "pending" \| "inactive"` | `"active"` | Figma Status: Active (Positive) · Disabled (Solid-Disabled) · Pending (Warning) · Inactive (Negative). |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xsmall" \| "small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"sm"` | Figma Size: XSmall 4px with a 1px ring · Small 8/2 · Medium 12/2 · Large 16/3. Short or Figma spelling. |
| `label` | `string` | — | What a screen reader says. Default: the status word from the labels ("Online", "Disabled", "Pending", "Inactive"). |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the dot from assistive technology when the status is said in text beside it. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLSpanElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<span>`. |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type AvatarStatusValue = "active" | "disabled" | "pending" | "inactive"
```

## ✅ Do
- Set alt to the person's name; use alt="" only when the name is shown next to the avatar.
- Use 2 initials (1 on xsmall/2xsmall).
- Use square avatars for workspaces and organisations.
- Popover items (Theme=Avatar Small) use Avatar Size=Small (32px); Avatar Big uses Medium (40px) — PopoverItem sizes them for you.
- A status beside a name without an avatar (a compact row, a list of people) is <AvatarStatus size="xs"> or "sm" before the text; the Avatar's own dot follows its size.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't show more than 5 avatars in a stack; summarise the rest in text.
- Don't use status without a text equivalent nearby ("Online").
- Don't put initials on a Solid golden, teal, cyan or orange avatar: the white initials measure 2.6–3.0:1. Use background="subtle" or a theme such as indigo, violet or purple; photos are fine (harness: avatar/solid-initials-contrast).

## Accessibility
- Without a photo, an avatar with alt is one image named by it (role=img): an AvatarStack of initials reads "Ava Nguyen, Minh Tran", not "AN MT". The status joins the name ("Ava Nguyen, Online" · "Pending" · "Disabled" · "Inactive"), alt="" hides the initials, and the stack's overflow avatar reads "+N". AvatarStatus is an image named by its status word (label= to change it); mark it decorative when the status is in the text beside it.

## Content
- Initials from given + family name.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `avatar/needs-alt` | error | Avatars need alt (the person's name; alt="" only when the name is shown next to it). | `zen-allow-avatar-alt: <reason>` |
| `avatar/solid-initials-contrast` | warn | Initials on a Solid golden, teal, cyan or orange Avatar fall below 3:1 contrast; use background="subtle" or another theme (photos are fine). | `zen-allow-avatar-contrast: <reason>` |
| `flag/no-emoji-flag` | warn | Country flags are the Flag component (Figma Flag set), not emoji flags: emoji render differently on every OS and Windows shows letters. | `zen-allow-emoji-flag: <reason>` |
| `api/overrides-studio-only` | error | `overrides` (Figma instance overrides of the layers a component draws itself: `{ "Sub-Action": { level: "danger" } }`) is written by Zen Studio on the pages it makes; hand-written code sets the component's own props or composes the parts (the user's call, 2026-10-10). | `zen-allow-overrides: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
